ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3 Consolidated Stable
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.9.3 Consolidated Stable for RimWorld 1.5. Single-DLL production build based on the validated V22 stable core with ReachProfile V0.4.18, plus the proven V23/V24 authority-safe S4 pruners and truthful validator telemetry. V25 JobGiver negative memo, V19-V21 ReachProfile experiments, resident hot-path diagnostics, PathSnapshot shadow validation, WorkPrefilter and other retired low-yield experiments are excluded from the production path.
